VERITY 1.3.0 adds optional folder awareness.

- Enable **Settings → File awareness** and choose a folder, including your home folder, for local search across supported PDFs, Word documents, text, and code.
- VERITY skips hidden folders, Library, and app packages. The local index is limited to 2,000 documents or 12 million characters.
- Original files stay on your Mac. Each AI question may send up to 8,000 characters of locally matched excerpts to NOVA. Disable folder awareness to remove the saved folder permission and index; earlier replies in an open chat remain.

Download the DMG, open it, and drag VERITY.app into Applications.
